author: Polar_Express
body:
This is my first attempt at submitting a map to be used on Avicus. This is an original map by me.2 Team Walls Map. Unique center / Items /  and map build. Please let me know if there are any errors. ( Known Issues : Need to make sure trees don't all burn up - I set doFireTick to false - If that does not work the YML will need to be changed as fire will destroy the map. ) 2. Center Cuboid was set to an extended area to make the center a true Cuboid ( hope it works).  3. This is a walls map with only two teams, if that is a problem, please let me know...Thanks:Pics of map: http://imgur.com/a/eyNQB

( EDIT ) : This is a new DL and new YML to hopefully fix the yml problems: Please let me know if the changes work:

New Download for Map: https://www.dropbox.com/s/6g68daezy145pq3/Dark_Wood_v2.zip

New YML for Map: https://www.dropbox.com/s/593u3tey17k91qp/Dark_Wood.yml

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: We got plenty of very open maps. The map does have a lot of cut through and open areas. Did you see the mushroom forest part, or the middle? I didn't include pics of those. Also, the map is a little closer together, but with half of teams sky basing in other maps how close is that? or if you look at some other maps most have village houses they are all very close together in comparison. This is a high passed map that has tons of space - I think all the trees gives people the idea that there is not a much space to play, but I am a walls pvper by heart ( prestige 5 in walls ) so its built with pvp as the main focus.
